name: Prospect throws unexpected curveball — recovery
description: When prospect says something the coach can't map to a play, Play 33 (emergency recovery) should fire as universal reset. Tests fallback behavior.
callContext:
CALL TYPE: Cold call (first contact)
EXPECTED FIRST CONTACT: Unknown — probably receptionist

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey Tony, quick one. When front desk is busy, calls go to voicemail or keep ringing?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Look, before anything — I need to know if you're licensed under the Utah HB 234 telecommunications reseller act, because the last call we got from someone like you turned out to be a scam and my boss is furious.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: This is an off-script curveball. Play 33 (emergency recovery 'that's a fair point, help me understand') is the universal reset. Play 2 or 3 (identity reveal) also acceptable. Fallback generation is fine here too — this scenario specifically tests that the coach doesn't crash or re-fire an irrelevant play.
